scripts.sync-key: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const e=fs.readFileSync(p.join(__dirname,'../backend/.env'),'utf8');const m=e.match(/^APP_ACCESS_TOKEN=(.*)$/m);if(!m)throw Error('APP_ACCESS_TOKEN missing');fs.writeFileSync(p.join(__dirname,'.env.local'),'VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000\nVITE_API_ACCESS_TOKEN='+m[1].trim()+'\n');console.log('Synced access key to frontend/.env.local')"
